About Us · Parkland, Florida

About AT Studio

AT Studio is a modern interior design studio in Parkland, Florida, led by designer and construction engineer Anastasia Tolstenko. We design and manage homes, new builds and commercial spaces from Miami to West Palm Beach – from the first concept to the final styled room.

Our Story

From Construction Engineering to Interior Design

Anastasia’s first education was in construction – she is an engineer by training, and that background shapes every project the studio takes on. She likes to work close to the build: kitchens, bathrooms, layouts and every detail that has to be right before the finishes go in. That is why she prefers larger projects – new construction, full remodels and complete furnishing – where design and construction are planned together.

The ideal moment to start, in her words, is when the house is still a “box”.There is time to discuss, approve and finalize every design decision. Her style is modern and European-inspired – detailed, creative interiors that go beyond the standard builder-basic.

Today AT Studio works with families, homeowners and developers across South Florida. Anastasia leads every project personally, coordinates architects, contractors and vendors, and keeps clients informed with a written report every Friday.
